about: The run crashed at 'started' before the session saved an outcomes file, so no note was edited. recover runs mark, which finds no outcomes file and edits nothing; the Edit guard, act and close follow. The run closes with both requests open, each quoted under Requests still open with a link to its note (area-mara). No note changes. The history entry is how 'recovered' with an empty failed list. Reading as in case 47: a run that crashed at 'started' was waiting for no flags file, so Notes changed outside the run is absent.
